# 7430 - 8-input NAND gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7430.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7430.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 10 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7430 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7430.png) | ![7430 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nand8.png) | ![7430 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nand8.png) |

A very tall empty NAND rectangle with eight inputs.

How to tell it on a drawing: Eight inputs.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A | input |  |  |
| 2 | B | input |  |  |

| 6 | F | input |  |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |

| 12 | H | input |  |  |

| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Y = NOT(A AND B AND C AND D AND E AND F AND G AND H) | Y is the NAND of A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN5430/SN7430/SN74LS30/SN74S30 datasheet SDLS099](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls30.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7430
